༄༅/ /chos kyi sgrol ma gtso 'khor gtor ma la brten nas bskang zhing gsol ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// chos kyi sgrol ma gtso 'khor gtor ma la brten nas bskang zhing gsol ba bzhugs so//

/na mo dharma tā ra ye/ chos kyi sgrol ma gtso 'khor gtor ma la brten nas bskang zhing gsol bar 'dod pas/ gtor tshogs ci 'byor ba bshams par sman raka gis sbags la/ rang yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan pas ngag tu 'di ltar brjod cing de'i don dran bzhin par bya ba ni/ hrīḥ mdun du me rlung dur khrod dkyil 'khor dbus| |chos kyi sgrol ma dkar dmar zhi mdangs can// me long thod pa thogs nas dgyes nyams bzhad// zhabs gnyis mnyam bzhengs dar dang rin chen brgyan// g.yas g.yon rgyab mdun ye shes dbang dam tshig /sha za mkha' 'gro ma mo mched sde gsum// a ma snying sgul khro mo dmar la sogs// 'khor tshogs char sprin 'khrigs 'dra gsal bar gyur// mdun gyi gtor ma mi dmigs stong pa'i dang*// rlung me thod sgyed mtshan ldan ka pā lar// sha lnga bdud rtsi dgra bgegs sha khrag tshogs// 'dod yon longs spyod nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur// oṃ*/āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ gsum brjod/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī dharma tā re dzñā na ḍā ki nī wa shyaṃ ḍā ki nī karma ḍā ki nī bhakṣa kar mā ra kar ha ri kar sa ma ye daṃ dzaḥdzaḥ i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ hrīḥ chos kyi sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa la// phyi nang gsang ba sman raka ba ling dang*// rta bong bya can mda' dar gser g.yu mtshon// go khrab la sogs mchod pa'i rjas kyi tshogs// dpag med nam mkha' gang ba'i tshogs sprul nas// gsol lo mchod do bskang ngo thugs dam bskang*// mchog thun dngos grub stsol zhig mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// bcol ba'i phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod// hrīḥ gdod nas dag pa'i ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// zhi tshul sgeg pa'i lang tsho rnam par bkra// me long thod pa thogs nas phrin las sgrub// dar dang rin chen rgyan ldan brjid pa'i sku// sngags bdag gtso mo khyod la bdag bstod do// ye shes dam tshig dbang dang las byed ba'i// mkha' 'gro sde bzhi za byed gsod byed ma// 'phrog byed ma mo phrin las khro mo dmar// a ma snying sgul ma mo bye ma 'bum// 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bdag bstod do// bhyoḥ

ye shes mkha' 'gro dbyings phyug ma mo khyod// las la rgyug tshe ma rungs sha za'i tshul// rngam gtsigs ḍā ru thod khrag rab thogs nas// chu rta la zhon stong gsum kun tu rgyug /zas su sha rus snying dang klad pa za// skom du khrag dang chu ser khu ba 'thung*// bran du sha za ma mo 'bum gyis bskor// pho nyar za gsod 'phrog byed khro mo 'gyed| |mthu rtsal thogs med drag mo 'khor bcas rnams// sngon tshe rig 'dzin slob dpon padma dang*// rgyal dbang skyob pa'i bka' dang dam tshig tshogs// nyer bar dran mdzod bdag cag dpon slob kyi// mi mthun dgra bgegs log 'dren myur du sgrol// sod rol chings gtubs ming yang med par mdzod// bdag gi tshe dpal 'byor tshogs rgyas pa dang*// bcol ba'i phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod/ */ces brjod la gshegs su gsol lo// zhes bstan srung ma gtor ma la brten nas bskang zhing gsol ba rgyun 'khyer du bya ba 'di'ang*/ khams skyo'i dbon po dkon mchog grags pas dgos gsungs par/ shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas smin drug zla ba'i gral tshes brgyad la gzhu spro lung du bris pa dge bar gyur cig// /sarba maṅga laṃ//
